edition_note: 1.6.2 changes no screen layout. The one surface it touches is the legacy import confirmation, whose behaviour was tightened: the answer now belongs to the exact bytes that were shown, prompts are per slot, and a second slot asking a question gets its own dialog instead of silently reusing the first one. These frames are that dialog re-rendered from the 1.6.2 tree.
method: Both frames inspected at native size. The wording is unchanged from 1.6.1 and is complete and unclipped in each language; the Russian body is the longer string and still fits the dialog at 1280x720. The accepted action carries the keyboard focus ring, and the dialog is the same themed ConfirmationDialog the game already uses for its unsaved-progress choice.
open_issues: Whether the wording is clear enough for a player, including whether the dialog should name the slot it is asking about, is an owner judgement in docs/HANDOFF.md
scope: Readable controls, no clipping or missing glyphs in the reviewed frames. Stylized presentation; no photorealism or AAA claim. Human playtesting stays an owner check in HANDOFF.md.
